title: Anker Prime 20,000mAh (200W Output): Power Your Laptop Anywhere
summary: Fast-charge two laptops and a phone simultaneously. The crisp digital display shows real-time wattage and battery health.
pros: Dual 100W USB-C PD 3.0 output ports (200W total combined output)
Real-time smart TFT color screen showing per-port watts & time remaining
cons: Heavier than low-wattage smartphone power banks (544g)
Premium price point compared to 30W/65W bricks
body:
## High-Wattage Desktop Power in Your Backpack

Standard portable batteries trickle-charge laptops or fail to negotiate high-wattage USB-C Power Delivery. The **Anker Prime 20,000mAh (200W)** solves this with two independent 100W bidirectional USB-C ports and one 65W USB-A port.

### Real-World Charging Telemetry

In our lab tests, the Anker Prime charged a 14-inch MacBook Pro from 10% to 80% in just 41 minutes while simultaneously fast-charging an iPhone at 27W—without throttling or overheating.

> Even better: via 100W USB-C input, the power bank itself recharges from 0% to 100% in just 1 hour and 15 minutes.

### Smart Digital Display

No more guessing what four blinking LED dots mean. The built-in color LCD displays exact battery percentage, input/output wattage for each individual port, internal temperature health, and estimated time until empty or full.
